pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Common guest-related Perl modules shared between qemu-server (VMs) and pve-container (LXC). Provides:
PVE::AbstractConfig — base config class for QEMU and LXC configs PVE::AbstractMigrate — base migration logic (local + live) PVE::GuestHelpers — shared guest lifecycle helpers PVE::Replication{,Config,State} — storage replication framework PVE::StorageTunnel — storage migration tunnel (uses websocket-tunnel binary) PVE::Tunnel — migration tunnel setup and teardown PVE::Mapping::{Dir,PCI,USB} — hardware/directory mapping configs PVE::VZDump::{Common,JobBase,Plugin} — backup framework base classes
Runtime: proxmox-websocket-tunnel (Rust binary, not yet ported) is needed only for live migration; local guest operations work without it.
